name: Matsushita Takerou
source:
Name: Takero Matsushita
Sex: Male
Age: 55 [spoiler](Deceased)[/spoiler]
Birthday: February 15
Profession: Owner of Matsushita Diner.
Likes: Mayumi, Ota, Matsushita Diner.
Dislikes: Customers who don't finish their food.
Hobbies: Fishing, Shogi.
Skills: Backflip, Thowing knives.

Takero Matsushita is Ota's father and Mayumi's husband. Takero is an ardent student of cooking and very particular about the ingredients he uses. Therefore, his diner attracts many customers but does not make a significant profit. Helping Mayumi is his first priority, decreasing his focus on the diner.

[Based from the in-game character description]

[spoiler]Takero has actually been deceased for over 5 years, at 55 years old, after suffering from a heart attack from overwork. Mayumi does not remember his death due to her dementia.[/spoiler]
